title: Chopper
description: CI-IOP, or Chopper as everyone called him, was a battered old Astromech Droid that dated back to the time of the Clone Wars. He crash-landed on the Syndulla family property in a downed Y-wing. Rescued by Hera, Chopper remained loyal to her for decades and followed her on her journey fighting against oppression. A surly Droid with a mind of his own, Chopper would fiercely defend his friends. He frequently went on undercover missions and had no qualms talking back to anyone within earshot—Rebel, Imperial, or otherwise.
